policy: A cohort manifest attests the collection context that assessment rows cannot carry by themselves (docs/PHASE-3-FINDINGS.md). `build_comparison` refuses to compare rows without the operator_controlled_single_run attestation. This cohort grades, under the CMS hospital CSV v3 profile, the facilities the sibling hospital-json-v3-2026-08-19 cohort recorded as format_outside_profile exclusions with a CSV-retrievable publication: nothing was re-drawn and nothing was added, so the two cohorts together account for every facility of the one committed sampling frame. Failures stay in the cohort as rows: a robots.txt disallow and this project's own size ceiling are NOT_GRADED with the reason, and a failed download is an F with the dated reason. The two cohorts must never be pooled into one distribution (docs/how-we-compare.md). Contact evidence stays in the local discovery registry and is never published.

collection.description: One serial, operator-invoked run of `mrf-honest scorecard --profile csv` per target under the default retrieval policy: identified User-Agent with a contact address, HTTPS only, robots.txt fetched and obeyed in code before every request, conditional revalidation against the verified cache, retry backoff, and the default 1 GiB decoded-size ceiling. One bounded GET per file, with a three-second pause between invocations. Two targets whose bodies were already in the verified cache from the sibling cohort's format classification moved no new body bytes.

sampling_frame.summary: One stratum, a complete enumeration: every facility of the committed 2026-08-19 seeded random draw (48 facilities from CMS's enumeration of 3024 acute-care, non-federal, 50-states-and-DC hospitals) whose cms-hpt.txt publication the sibling JSON cohort recorded as a CSV-retrievable format_outside_profile exclusion - 25 of the 32 format exclusions; the other 7 are ZIP archives and remain excluded there. Every target is a row in this cohort, graded or stated. Totals describe this cohort, not hospitals as a class, and must never be pooled with the JSON cohort.
sampling_frame.format_rule: A target is graded only where the publication is a CMS hospital CSV document (Tall or Wide). Format was read from the publication during the sibling cohort's review, never from a failed request: the URL's file extension decides where it has one; where it has none, a specific declared media type decides; where the declaration is generic, the retrieved document decides. A ZIP archive is a container, not a CSV file, and grading one against this profile would measure the wrong thing; the 7 ZIP publications remain recorded exclusions of the sibling cohort. A .csv publication whose retrieval failed stays in this cohort and is graded F with the dated reason.

discovery.method: Targets are the sibling cohort's CSV-retrievable format_outside_profile exclusions. For each, the MRF URL is the one the facility's own retrieved cms-hpt.txt published for the matching location entry in the local discovery registry; no URL was hand-assembled. publisher_id is the registrable label of the cms-hpt.txt origin; location_id is the facility name the sibling exclusion recorded, slugged.
